                             1             Plaintiff Meta Platforms, Inc. (“Meta”) alleges the following:
                             2                                        I.         INTRODUCTION
                             3             1.     Since no later than April 2022 and continuing to at least February 2025, Defendant
                             4   Daniel Folger sold Instagram usernames and unauthorized Instagram account reinstatement
                             5   services. Defendant’s account reinstatement service was intended to circumvent enforcement
                             6   actions taken by Meta in response to users who violated the Instagram Terms of Use (“Terms”)
                             7   and other rules that govern access to and use of Instagram, including Instagram’s Community
                             8   Guidelines (collectively, “Instagram Terms and Policies”).
                             9             2.     On March 28, 2023, in an effort to stop Defendant’s unlawful conduct, Meta sent a
                            10   cease-and-desist letter to Defendant, revoked his license to access Facebook and Instagram, and
                            11   disabled his user accounts. Subsequently, Defendant created and used new Instagram accounts
DAVIS WRIGHT TREMAINE LLP




                            12   and continued to offer for sale Instagram usernames and Instagram account reinstatement services.
                            13             3.     Defendant’s conduct was not authorized by Meta and violates the Instagram Terms,
                            14   as well as the California Comprehensive Computer Data Access and Fraud Act, California Penal
                            15   Code § 502 (the “CDAFA”). Accordingly, Meta brings this action for damages and injunctive
                            16   relief.
                            17                                             II.     PARTIES
                            18             4.     Plaintiff Meta is a Delaware corporation with its principal place of business in
                            19   Menlo Park, San Mateo County, California.
                            20             5.     Defendant Daniel Folger is a resident of Henderson, Nevada. Between April 2022
                            21   and at least February 2025, Folger violated the Terms by offering for sale and selling Instagram
                            22   usernames and unauthorized Instagram account reinstatement services.

                            22   Terms which contains a forum selection clause that requires Defendant to submit to the personal

                            23   jurisdiction of the United States District Court for the Northern District of California or a state

                            24   court located in San Mateo County.

                            26   targeted his conduct at Meta—which has its principal place of business in California. Defendant

                            27   provided unauthorized account reinstatement services by conspiring with at least one Meta

                             6          10.     Pursuant to Civil L.R. 3-2(c), this case may be assigned to either the San Francisco
                             7   or Oakland division because Meta is located in San Mateo County.
                             8                                 IV.     FACTUAL ALLEGATIONS
                             9          A.      Background on Meta Products
                            10          11.     Meta owns and operates Instagram, which is a free photo and video sharing service,
                            11   website, and mobile application. Instagram users can upload photos and videos to Instagram and
DAVIS WRIGHT TREMAINE LLP




                            12   share them with others. They can also view, comment, and like posts shared by others on
                            13   Instagram.
                            14          12.     Meta also owns and operates Facebook, which is an online service that is available
                            15   on computers and mobile devices which helps give people the power to build community, share
                            16   life’s moments and discuss what’s happening, and discover and connect to interests through Feed,
                            17   Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more.
                            18          13.     Meta also owns WhatsApp, an encrypted communication service available on
                            19   mobile devices and desktop computers. WhatsApp relies on Meta’s infrastructure such as servers
                            20   to support people around the world with fast and reliable services.
                            21          B.      Instagram’s Terms
                            22          14.     Everyone who creates an account or uses Instagram must agree to Instagram’s
                            23   Terms and therefore has notice of the Terms.
                            24          15.     The Terms prohibit users from doing “anything unlawful, misleading, or fraudulent
                            25   or for an illegal or unauthorized purpose.”
                            26          16.     The Terms prohibit users from “sell[ing], licens[ing], or purchas[ing] any account
                            27   or data obtained from [Meta] or [Instagram],” including “attempts to buy, sell, or transfer any
                            28   aspect of your account (including your username); solicit, collect, or use login credentials or
                                                                                   3

                             1   badges of other users; or request or collect Instagram usernames, passwords, or misappropriate
                             2   access tokens.”
                             3          17.     The Terms prohibit users from “misusing any reporting, dispute, or appeals
                             4   channel, such as by making fraudulent or groundless reports or appeals.”
                             5          18.     The Terms prohibit users from doing “anything to interfere with or impair the
                             6   intended operation of [Instagram].”
                             7          19.     The Terms state that a person cannot use Instagram if Meta has previously disabled
                             8   the user’s account for violating any of Meta’s policies.

                             4          D.      Meta’s Enforcement Measures
                             5          25.     Meta has a variety of measures and tools in place to enforce the Terms and Policies.
                             6          26.     Content Removal: Meta uses technology and human review teams to detect and
                             7   review potentially violating content and accounts on Instagram. Meta’s technology is used to
                             8   proactively detect and remove violating content from Instagram and send potentially violating
                             9   content to review teams to check it and take appropriate enforcement action as needed. If Meta
                            10   determines that an Instagram user has violated the Terms and Policies, the Terms give Meta the
                            11   right to “remove or restrict any content or information you share on the Service.”
DAVIS WRIGHT TREMAINE LLP




                            12          27.     Account Access Restriction and Termination: The Terms give Meta the right to
                            13   “terminat[e] or disabl[e] your access to [Instagram] to protect [Meta’s] community or services.”
                            14   Meta may also restrict certain Instagram features if it appears that an account is not following the
                            15   Terms and Policies.
                            16          28.     Appeal Channels: If Meta disables or restricts an Instagram account and the user
                            17   believes the enforcement was by mistake, the user may appeal Meta’s enforcement. Users whose
                            18   accounts are disabled will automatically receive instructions about how to appeal the enforcement
                            19   the next time they attempt to access their Instagram account. Users whose accounts are restricted
                            20   can appeal those restrictions in the Instagram App using the Account Status tool. Meta also has
                            21   an internal appeal channel for its employees and certain contractors to request assistance with their
                            22   own accounts or accounts belonging to their family and friends (“Internal Appeal Channel”). The
                            23   Terms prohibit users from misusing all appeal and reporting channels. Only Meta is authorized to
                            24   reinstate accounts or account access or lift account restrictions after an enforcement.

                                                                       (Breach of Contract)

                            11   Meta.

                            13   accordance with the Terms by providing the Instagram service.

                            15   fraudulent or for an illegal or unauthorized purpose”; (2) ”misusing any reporting, dispute, or
                            16   appeals channel, such as by making fraudulent or groundless reports or appeals”; (3) “solicit[ing],

                            21   the intended operation of [Instagram].” Defendant has breached these Terms by offering for sale
                            22   and selling Instagram usernames; reinstating disabled or otherwise restricted Instagram user
                            23   accounts; misusing Meta appeal channels; and collecting and using Instagram users’ usernames
                            24   and passwords in furtherance of his scheme.

                            26   disabled that person’s user account for violating any of Meta’s Terms and Policies. Defendant
                            27   breached this Term by creating multiple new Instagram accounts and continuing to use Instagram
